review.notes: All 20 acceptance criteria (AC-A1–A10, AC-B1–B10) pass. Four minor findings and two info findings were identified; none block correctness of the spec objectives. Three minors (F1 tooltip, F2 test fixture upsert, F6 Primary Key DataClassification) were immediately addressed before commit. F3 (SessionStartTime not populated) and F4 (SourceBuffer parameter unused) are pre-existing design issues not introduced by these specs.
review.skills-compliance: BCQuality active (bundled): al-privacy-review (B1-B8 pass + F6 CustomerContent fix applied), al-style-review (tooltip gap found and fixed), al-performance-review (SetAutoCalcFields fix confirmed), al-appsource-review (metadata populated, URL depth verified). Native: extension-only compliance confirmed; test codeunit structure validated; GIVEN/WHEN/THEN pattern confirmed in 3 new tests.

findings.message: The 'Transaction ID' field (Rec.Name) on the TroubleShooting Assitance Transactions page had no ToolTip property.
findings.fix-hint: Added ToolTip = 'The unique identifier of the database transaction that grouped these changes.'; inside the field block.

findings.message: SetDirectCapture() in the test helper called Setup.Modify() on a record returned by GetSetup() that may not exist in the database in a fresh CI environment, causing a record-not-found runtime error.
findings.fix-hint: Replaced GetSetup/Modify with an upsert: if not Setup.Get('') then Insert(false) else Modify().

findings.message: The page-global variable SessionStartTime (DateTime) declared on the TroubleShooting Assitance Transactions page is never assigned. SetData() signature does not accept StartTime, so drill-through Results page always shows epoch (0DT) as recording start time.
findings.fix-hint: Extend SetData's signature to accept StartTime: DateTime, assign SessionStartTime := StartTime, update all call sites.

findings.message: The 'var SourceBuffer: Record TroubleShooting Assitance Change Buffer' parameter in SetData() is never read inside the procedure body. The implementation re-queries the database by RunId.
findings.fix-hint: Either (a) remove the SourceBuffer parameter and document the page is for post-stop analysis only, or (b) iterate SourceBuffer for grouping instead of re-querying.

findings.message: The privacyStatement field in app.json points to docs/OVERVIEW.md rather than a dedicated privacy policy. AppSource validation expects a URL that describes personal data collection, usage, and user rights.
findings.fix-hint: Replace privacyStatement URL with an actual privacy policy page, or create docs/privacy-policy.md and link to it.

findings.message: Field 7 'Primary Key' (Text[500]) in TroubleShooting Assitance Change Buffer stores actual primary key values of captured tables (can contain customer-entered data). CustomerContent is more accurate than the inherited SystemMetadata.
findings.fix-hint: Added DataClassification = CustomerContent; inside field(7; 'Primary Key'; Text[500]).
